title: Tidal Locking Simulator — Why We See One Moon Face | Space Atlas
description: Use a tidal locking simulator to compare the real Moon with a non-locked Moon and see why the same lunar face stays pointed at Earth.
ogTitle: Tidal Locking Simulator — Why We See One Side of the Moon
ogDescription: Toggle tidal locking on and off and track a surface marker to see synchronous rotation happen.
jsonldDescription: An interactive Moon tidal-locking simulator comparing synchronous rotation with a hypothetical non-locked Moon.
